QUOTE: Fuzzy edges are kept in `callers`/`callees`. The source says 21.3% of clew's own call edges are fuzzy, and 79.8% on a large C++ target. `chain_trace` filters them out; the flat list does not.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the flat list keeps fuzzy edges and `chain_trace` filters them, but it never gives the reason that a walk expands each hop, so one fuzzy edge multiplies into a wrong subtree.
